project_type: FairWatt Home: Next.js static site + Python build-time models. THIS task is Python backend-only; a separate teammate builds the UI. Outputs are committed static JSON the frontend reads from the repo.
build_system: No Python build step; scripts are run directly with python3. The JS app (not touched here) uses npm/Next.js 16.4.2. node_modules is NOT installed in this tree.
test_framework: pytest 9.0.3 (run as `python3 -m pytest`). numpy 2.2.5, scipy 1.15.3, pandas 2.3.3, openpyxl 3.1.5 are all available. No new dependencies needed or allowed.
build_command: cd fairwatt-kit && python3 forecast_mc_build.py   (then)  python3 allcities_build.py
test_command: cd fairwatt-kit && python3 -m pytest forecast_mc_test.py allcities_test.py -q
verification_instructions: 1) Run both builders; confirm data/build/forecast_mc.json and data/build/allcities_forecast.json are written. 2) Run pytest for both test files; all pass. 3) Parse both JSON files and assert the P10<=P50<=P90 band invariant holds in every month (MC) and every town-month (all-cities), 351 towns, droppedTowns reconciles, baselineMape sales in [5.5,6.5]. 4) Re-run a builder with the same seed and confirm byte-identical output (determinism).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Builders generate data/build/forecast_mc.json and data/build/allcities_forecast.json (both committed). allcities_build also writes data/build/allcities_towns_cache.json (cached 351-town name list; committed, allcities_-prefixed, mine). data/build/ does not exist yet and must be created by the builders (os.makedirs). Produce with the two build_command scripts.
environment_constraints: GIT: the working tree is the PARENT 'Trading Folder' repo (branch feat/option-dashboard) with many unrelated uncommitted changes. The .kiro/hooks/guard_git.py PreToolUse hook BLOCKS `git add -A`, `git add .`, checkout, switch, stash, reset, rebase, clean. Stage ONLY your own new files BY NAME. Commit (subject prefixed e.g. 'forecaster-mc: ...'); NEVER push. NETWORK: the all-cities town-list fetch (LMEC GeoJSON on raw.githubusercontent.com) is a permitted build-time download; it was reachable this session. It must be fetched at most once and cached. No OTHER runtime network calls.
contribution_requirements: agent-rules.md: (#1) no invented numbers - every constant traces to ground-truth.md, data/, or code run on them; (#3) fail closed on bad/missing data; (#4/#8) own ONLY your files - do NOT touch stats_*/savings_*/map_* (sibling), hmm_* (sibling), contracts/, .kiro/hooks/, scaffold/ source, package.json, data/build/towns*; (#11) anything not from the user's typed numbers is 'estimated'. structure.md ownership: forecast_mc_* and allcities_* files are NEW paths you create and own. Keep functions pure/importable (no I/O at import).
key_patterns: VERIFIED baseline (reproduced this session on data/snapshot/eia_ma_monthly_2026-08.csv): same-month-last-year MAPE = 5.95% on sales_mwh, 6.01% on kwh_per_customer, n=188 (ground-truth says ~5.9%/6.0%). ERROR MODEL for the MC: pooled log-residual e=ln(actual/same-month-last-year-pred) has n=188, mean~=-0.0008, sd~=0.0733; exp(P10/P50/P90)~=0.911/1.000/1.096. Per calendar month there are 15-16 residuals (>=8 threshold the repo's forecast specs use), so use PER-CALENDAR-MONTH empirical residual quantiles, with pooled residuals as the documented fallback if a month has <8. BOOTSTRAP empirical residuals (not a fitted normal) to keep real tails. Back-transform: path = baseline * exp(residual_draw). DETERMINISM: numpy.random.default_rng(seed=20270201), n_sims=10000; same seed+same CSV => identical JSON. HORIZON: info set ends 2026-08; six forecast months = 2026-11,2026-12,2027-01,2027-02,2027-03,2027-04 (matches bill-forecast.md); months >= 2027-02 are postReset=true (the Feb 1 2027 reset). UNITS: kwh_per_customer_month (use the EIA kwh_per_customer column; raw customer counts are noisy per ground-truth). SEASONAL SHAPE (sales share, mean 2019-2025): Jan .094 Feb .0867 Mar .0802 Apr .0716 May .0685 Jun .0783 Jul .1044 Aug .1044 Sep .0851 Oct .0708 Nov .0701 Dec .0857 - summer peaks ~= January, NEVER hard-code 'winter'. NO TOWN-LEVEL DATA EXISTS: RECS has no town column, EIA is state-total, towns.json carries only geometry+geoid (no population/usage). So EVERY town forecast is the shared state per-customer path, labeled scaling='state-shaped', thinHistory=true, honestly (agent-rules #1/#11). TOWN LIST: 351 towns, massgis_town_id 1..351, massgis_name (UPPER join key), census_name (display), GEOID (25+8 digits). Read data/build/towns.json IF present else fetch LMEC GeoJSON https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nblmc/massachusetts-municipal-boundaries/main/data-cooked/mass-municipalities.geojson and cache names to data/build/allcities_towns_cache.json; NEVER write data/raw/** or data/build/towns*.

New Python files go at the fairwatt-kit/ root with forecast_mc_* / allcities_* prefixes.
